verdict.rationale: Visa publishes the Trusted Agent Protocol reference implementation (tap-agent, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend, agent-registry) under an open license, and the Agent Toolkit MCP server sits in a public GitHub repo. The core Intelligent Commerce platform (tokenization, mandates, credential APIs) is served only as credential-gated APIs, with no published source. Missing for 10: open source of the core Intelligent Commerce platform, an explicitly named license (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the TAP and agent-toolkit repos, independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: the repo ships a reference implementation (agent-registry, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend, tap-agent) under an open license.
